source:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  title Order Checkout
  box rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14) Edge
    actor User
    participant Web
  end
  participant API
  participant DB
  User->>+Web: Place order
  Web->>+API: POST /orders
  API->>+DB: INSERT order
  alt Payment OK
    DB-->>-API: order_id
    Note over API: Emit OrderCreated
    API-->>-Web: 201 Created
  else Declined
    API-->>Web: 402 Payment Required
  end
  Web-->>-User: Show receipt
